Empirical Verification & Methodology
Evidence, Audit & Data Integrity

An audit of SRMIST's published admissions data (reproducible; steps below), empirical Lighthouse measurements, identified contradictions, and dataset verification reports. Every number on this page is read directly from automated test results or computed from primary datasets.

106 Campus Offerings

Total individual B.Tech campus offerings parsed and verified from SRM’s official Programs Offered table.

48 Distinct Programmes

Distinct engineering degree specialisations across all 6 campuses, with 23 multi-campus.

6 SRMIST Campuses

Kattankulathur, Ramapuram, Tiruchirappalli, Vadapalani, Delhi NCR, and Baburayanpettai on 1 entrance form.

75 Eligibility Conflicts

Offerings where SRM’s row states 50% aggregate (SRMJEEE 2022) but general criteria mandate 60%.

Part 1
What we measured on SRM's homepage

Audit executed using Lighthouse 13.6.0 and Chrome DevTools Lighthouse 13.5.0 with Moto G Power mobile profile and simulated Slow 4G (1.6 Mbps down, 750 Kbps up, 150ms round-trip). Figures represent the medians of consecutive runs. When two runners disagree for the same page, both are reported below.

Page Under Audit	Runner	Version	Runs	Performance	Accessibility	Best Practices	SEO	LCP (Median)	FCP (Median)	TBT (Median)	Page Weight
SRM Homepage Live Production Server Inspect live ↗	Chrome DevTools (Author)	13.5.0	single run	40	81	96	85	12.4s	3.8s	750ms	9.9 MB (10,167 KiB)
SRM Homepage Live Production Server Inspect live ↗	Lighthouse CLI (Automated)	13.6.0	median of 3 runs	34	81	77	83	30.1s	15.8s	958ms	9.6 MB (9,840 KiB)
SRM Compass Home Compass Prototype (Edge) Open page →	Lighthouse CLI (Automated)	13.6.0	median of 3 runs	98	100	100	100	887ms	887ms	105ms	12 KiB
SRM Compass Mechanical Engineering Compass Prototype (Edge) Open page →	Lighthouse CLI (Automated)	13.6.0	median of 3 runs	99	100	100	100	945ms	945ms	8ms	12 KiB
Methodology Note: SRM's live site measurements reflect production server latency and third-party script overhead; Compass figures represent an optimized pre-rendered prototype running on Cloudflare edge. Both DevTools and CLI runner measurements are reported when runners disagree.
Part 2
Contradictions in SRM's own pages

Direct discrepancies discovered during primary source extraction, verified by inspecting live DOM elements, published brochures, and official admission application forms.

Eligibility Criteria: 60% vs 50% Threshold
Official Statement A

Minimum 60% aggregate in Physics, Mathematics, and one qualifying subject for B.Tech admission (2026-27 criteria).

[S2] Primary link ↗ Captured 26 Oct 2026
vs
Conflicting Statement B

Minimum 50% aggregate citing historical SRMJEEE 2022 rules printed directly inside the active Programs Offered table.

[S1] Primary link ↗ Captured 26 Oct 2026
Scope: 75 of 106 offering rows carry this discrepancy in SRM's own published tables.
Compass Handling: SRM Compass flags each row as a conflict, warns applicants, and links directly to both sections on SRM's site.
Programme Nomenclature: Engineering vs Intelligence
Official Statement A

Claim A: "Artificial Engineering & Future Technologies" appears in the 2026-27 brochure (B3) and SRM's B.Tech application page (S3).

[B3, S3] Primary link ↗ Captured 28 Oct 2026
vs
Conflicting Statement B

Claim B: "Artificial Intelligence & Future Technologies" appears in the Programs Offered table (S1).

[S1] Primary link ↗ Captured 26 Oct 2026
Scope: 1 offering, Tiruchirappalli
Compass Handling: Compass indexes both names so student search queries succeed regardless of which variant is typed.
Institutional Ranking: NIRF 2025 vs 2024 Ranking
Official Statement A

Prominently marketed as NIRF 2025 Ranked 11th in the 2026-2027 Admission Brochure.

[B3] Primary link ↗ Captured 28 Oct 2026
vs
Conflicting Statement B

Displayed as NIRF Ranked 12th in the 2024 University category on the live online B.Tech application portal.

[S3] Primary link ↗ Captured 26 Oct 2026
Scope: Institutional marketing banner across prospectus vs online application portal.
Compass Handling: Documented with exact capture timestamps to clarify ranking edition and category differences for prospective students.
Placement Statistics: 14,030+ vs 5,700+ Offers Without Stated Scope
Official Statement A

Headlined as "14,030+ Job Offers" in brochure overview marketing without specifying graduating batch year or campus boundary.

[B3] Primary link ↗ Captured 28 Oct 2026
vs
Conflicting Statement B

Displayed as "5,700+ Job Offers" on the current B.Tech application header banner with no cohort or scope specified.

[S3] Primary link ↗ Captured 26 Oct 2026
Scope: Campus-wide career marketing claims seen by prospective applicants.
Compass Handling: Compass highlights that neither number specifies whether it includes off-campus offers, non-engineering faculties, or multi-campus aggregates.

Part 4
How to reproduce

Any auditor or juror can independently reproduce every assertion, calculation, and schema guard:

1. The Automated Verification Command

Run the verification script to re-audit all 106 offerings and stories against their source schemas:

npm run verify

Executes scripts/verify.ts, validating required facts, source timestamps, and conflict markers.

2. Cryptographic Hash Guard

Every underlying data file is guarded by a SHA-256 hash in data/HASHES.json, tested automatically on every run:

npm test

The Vitest suite confirms that zero bytes in data/ or data/evidence/lighthouse.json have been altered without audit trail.

3. Primary Source Links

Inspect the three fundamental official sources from which the core engineering dataset is derived:

[S1] SRMIST Programs Offered table (Engineering): https://www.srmist.edu.in/admission-india/engineering/ ↗ (Captured 26 Oct 2026)
[S2] SRMIST B.Tech / M.Tech Integrated eligibility criteria 2026-2027: https://www.srmist.edu.in/admission-india/engineering/ ↗ (Captured 26 Oct 2026)
[S3] SRMIST online application page for B.Tech: https://applications.srmist.edu.in/btech ↗ (Captured 26 Oct 2026)
Part 5
Limits of this evidence
Single Machine Lighthouse Benchmarks: All Lighthouse runs were executed on a single host machine with Chrome DevTools simulated mobile throttling (Moto G Power, Slow 4G). Real-world user metrics vary based on cellular connectivity, device hardware, and CDN cache state.
Prototype Status & Usability Testing: SRM Compass is an independent prototype design entry. While automated Axe-core accessibility (0 violations) and keyboard navigation audits are strictly verified, extensive 5-person real-user lab usability trials remain to be conducted by human evaluators.
Sourced vs. Verified Tiers: Data points are strictly partitioned into verified (mathematically validated from official tables) and sourced (as published by SRM; not independently checked).
Admissions Cycle Scope: All data was captured on 26 October 2026 for the 2026-27 admission cycle. SRMIST retains administrative authority to update fees, seat capacities, and eligibility rules for 2027 entry.
Rule Text Correction: The earlier rule text was abridged and was corrected on 31 Oct 2026.
